# Objective

Apply production hygiene to `jiangyun-fun/sam-tagger` (license, CI, release
automation, dependency bumps, repo settings, topics) and cut release **v3.0.0**
with source/wheel artifacts — the inputs the user's later conda recipe consumes.

# Starting state (verified)

- Repo `jiangyun-fun/sam-tagger` existed on GitHub, **private**, default branch
  `main`; local `a9dea68` == `origin/main`.
- No `LICENSE` (but `pyproject.toml` declared `license = "MIT"`); no
  `.github/workflows`; no Dependabot; no topics; no tags/releases; default
  settings (all merge methods on, `delete_branch_on_merge=false`, projects on).
- Stack: **pixi + conda** (`python 3.13.*`, `pysam>=0.22` from bioconda; PyPI
  deps polars/cyclopts/loguru/pydantic; editable self-install). `linux-64` only.
  `pixi.lock` was gitignored (untracked) — later overridden, see below.

# Decisions (as-built)

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Visibility | **Keep private** | User request; release/tag become public automatically when the repo is flipped later. |
| Branch protection | **Skip (deferred)** | Blocked on private repos without GitHub Pro (403). Revisit when public. |
| License | **MIT** | Already declared in `pyproject.toml`. |
| CI | **pixi-based** (`setup-pixi@v0.10.0`) | `pysam` is conda-only; `pip`-based CI cannot install it. `ubuntu-latest` == `linux-64`. |
| Release artifacts | **sdist + wheel** (`python -m build`) | Inputs a conda recipe consumes. |
| `pixi.lock` | **Committed** | `setup-pixi cache:true` needs it for the cache key; also gives a reproducible solve. |
| Dependabot | **`github-actions` only** | `pip`-ecosystem Dependabot would drift PyPI deps vs the pixi solve (pysam conda-only). |
| Version | **v3.0.0** | Matches `pyproject.toml` / `pixi.toml`. |

# Steps (all done)

1. ✅ **LICENSE** — MIT added (Yun Jiang, 2026).
2. ✅ **`pyproject.toml`** — `readme` + `[project.urls]`.
3. ✅ **`pixi.toml`** — `build` task + `build` dev dep.
4. ✅ **`README.md`** — CI/release/license/python badges.
5. ✅ **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`** — job `ci`, pixi gate, `setup-pixi@v0.10.0`.
6. ✅ **`.github/workflows/release.yml`** — tag `v*.*.*` → build → attach.
7. ✅ **`.github/dependabot.yml`** — `github-actions`, weekly, grouped.
8. ✅ **Commit + push** — `ca6728f`; then `9450d88` (lock fix) after first CI failed.
9. ✅ **CI green** — run `30967572496` (33s), all 5 steps ✓.
10. ✅ **Settings** — squash-only, `delete_branch_on_merge`, projects off; description.
11. ✅ **Topics** — 8 added.
12. ✅ **Tag `v3.0.0`** + push → release workflow run `30967697840` (36s) ✓.
13. ✅ **Release live** with sdist + wheel; curated notes via `gh release edit`.
14. ✅ Report written; this plan rewritten in place.

# Files

- **Created**: `LICENSE`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/release.yml`,
  `.github/dependabot.yml`, `pixi.lock` (newly tracked), this plan + the report.
- **Edited**: `pyproject.toml`, `pixi.toml`, `README.md`, `.gitignore`.

# Key deviation: committing `pixi.lock`

The first CI run failed in 13s with *"Failed to generate cache key"* because
`setup-pixi@v0.10.0`'s `cache: true` hashes `pixi.lock`, which was gitignored.
Committed the lock (verified in sync via `pixi install --frozen`); `.gitignore`
now ignores only `.pixi/`. This also makes CI reproducible. Report has details.

# Verification

- CI run `30967572496` green (lint+typecheck+test); release run `30967697840` green.
- `gh release view v3.0.0` → wheel + sdist attached.
- Local `pixi run -e dev build` → `dist/` artifacts (wheel has all 13 modules);
  `pixi run -e dev test` → 126 passed.

# Follow-ups (out of scope)

- Make repo public → then enable branch protection (`contexts: ["ci"]`,
  `enforce_admins: false`).
- Merge Dependabot PR #1 (`actions/checkout` 4→7) — silences the Node 20
  deprecation annotation.
- Conda package (user).
